text.en: An interactive scale reference that maps musical intervals and notes across a configurable guitar fretboard.
text.zhTW: 把音樂音程與音名映射到可設定吉他指板的互動音階參考。

text.en: Scale Explorer lets visitors choose a root and scale, inspect the resulting notes and intervals, view them on the fretboard, hear the scale, and download a generated diagram.
text.zhTW: 音階探索器讓訪客選擇根音與音階、查看結果音名與音程、在指板上檢視、聆聽音階並下載產生的圖表。

text.en: The implementation joins scale spelling, interval identity, fretboard location, sound, and a portable visual in one reference flow.
text.zhTW: 從實作回溯可見，它把音階拼寫、音程身分、指板位置、聲音與可攜視覺整合在同一參考流程。

text.en: Select a musical scale, change the visible neck range, explore positions, play the notes, and export the diagram.
text.zhTW: 選擇音階、改變可見琴頸範圍、探索位置、播放音名並匯出圖表。

text.en: Commit 0053346 introduced the interactive Scale Explorer; a same-day follow-up added selectable guitar neck lengths.
text.zhTW: Commit 0053346 推出互動音階探索器；同日後續變更加入可選吉他琴頸長度。

text.en: Root and scale selection with generated notes and fretboard positions.
text.zhTW: 根音與音階選擇，以及產生的音名與指板位置。

text.en: Selectable neck lengths, playback, and downloadable scale diagrams were added during the launch-day sequence.
text.zhTW: 可選琴頸長度、播放與可下載音階圖在推出日的一系列變更中加入。

text.en: Page heading → sound controls → selected-scale summary → fretboard visualization → playback and download actions.
text.zhTW: 頁面標題 → 聲音控制 → 所選音階摘要 → 指板視覺化 → 播放與下載操作。

text.en: scale.html and styles/scale.css define the controls, summary, fretboard regions, and responsive presentation.
text.zhTW: scale.html 與 styles/scale.css 定義控制、摘要、指板區域與響應式呈現。

text.en: The Vue frontend owns scale selection, note spelling, range controls, fretboard rendering, canvas image generation, downloads, playback, and URL parameters.
text.zhTW: Vue 前端管理音階選擇、音名拼寫、範圍控制、指板渲染、canvas 圖片產生、下載、播放與網址參數。

text.en: Controls and a broad fretboard visualization use the available horizontal range.
text.zhTW: 控制與寬廣指板視覺會利用可用水平範圍。

text.en: Configurable neck range limits the amount of fretboard information that must remain legible as width narrows.
text.zhTW: 從實作回溯可見，可設定琴頸範圍可限制寬度縮小時仍需保持可讀的指板資訊量。

text.en: Shared mobile polish stacks controls and preserves download behavior, including an iOS preview fallback.
text.zhTW: 共用行動版改善會堆疊控制並保留下載行為，包括 iOS 預覽回退。

text.en: The tool joined the public site with interactive scale and fretboard exploration.
text.zhTW: 工具以互動音階與指板探索加入公開網站。

text.en: A launch-day refinement made the displayed guitar range configurable.
text.zhTW: 推出日改善讓顯示的吉他範圍可設定。

text.en: Generated scale visuals became portable downloads.
text.zhTW: 產生的音階視覺成為可攜下載。

text.en: Shared localization extended the public tool to Traditional Chinese.
text.zhTW: 共用在地化讓公開工具支援繁體中文。

text.en: The explorer joined the completed v2.0.5 Vue migration while retaining its scale, playback, URL-state, and download behavior.
text.zhTW: 探索器納入 v2.0.5 完成的 Vue 遷移，同時保留音階、播放、網址狀態與下載行為。

text.en: Scale Explorer is a Vue-owned bilingual browser tool at /scale.html with configurable roots, scale types, fretboard ranges, note and interval rendering, playback, downloads, and URL-driven initial state.
text.zhTW: 音階探索器目前是由 Vue 管理、位於 /scale.html 的雙語瀏覽器工具，包含可設定根音、音階種類、指板範圍、音名與音程渲染、播放、下載及網址驅動初始狀態。

text.en: A reference becomes more reusable when the same musical model can be seen, heard, constrained to a useful range, and exported.
text.zhTW: 當相同音樂模型可被觀看、聆聽、限制於實用範圍並匯出時，參考工具會更可重用。

text.en: No original wireframe or documented rationale for the initial default scale was found.
text.zhTW: 未找到原始線框圖或初始預設音階的書面理由。
